item.name: Tenets of the Silver Hand
tooltip: Equip: Increases your damage against Undead by 1%.
"A pristine copy of the holy tome."

item.name: Polished Driftwood Icon
tooltip: Equip: Allows 8% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

item.name: Formula: Enchant Weapon - Insight
tooltip: Use: Permanently enchant a Melee Weapon to have a chance to grant Insight when you cast a spell, increasing Spirit by 100% for 10 sec.
"Teaches you how to permanently enchant a weapon to grant a chance to gain Insight when you cast a spell, which gives +5% Spirit for a short duration."

item.name: Formula: Enchant Weapon - Recovery
tooltip: Use: Permanently enchant a Melee Weapon to trigger Recovery when you are Parried or Dodged, healing you for 5% of your maximum health. Cannot occur more often than once every 10 sec.

"Teaches you how to permanently enchant a weapon to grant a chance to trigger Recovery when your attacks are dodged or parried, which heals you for 5% of your maximum health. Cannot occur more than once every 10 sec."

item.name: Formula: Enchant Weapon - Revelation
tooltip: Use: Permanently enchant a Melee Weapon to have a chance to trigger Revelation when a non-periodic spell fails to critically strike. Revelation grants 100% increased critical strike chance to the next non-periodic spell cast. Revelation's chance to trigger is diminished as your critical strike chance increases.

"Teaches you how to permanently enchant a weapon to grant a chance to trigger Revelation when your direct spells fail to deal a critical strike. Revelation grants 100% increased critical strike chance to your next spell cast."

campObjects.name: Enchanted Lute
campObjects.description: Armor, stats and resistances to everyone sitting nearby, like Mark of the Wild (at level 60, scaling with level)

item.name: Enchanted Lute
tooltip: Use: Summons an enchanted lute that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 308 Armor, 13 increase to all stats, and 22 increase to all resistances, mutually exclusive with Mark of the Wild. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hr. (60 Min Cooldown)

campObjects.name: Arcane Salvager
campObjects.description: Disenchants more efficiently, and gives the Enchanted Lute buff

item.name: Arcane Salvager
tooltip: Use: Places an Arcane Salvager that enables more efficient disenchanting, and provides all the benefits of an Enchanted Lute. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over an Enchanted Lute to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hr. (60 Min Cooldown)

blueprint.name: Blueprint: Arcane Salvager
tooltip: "Teaches you how to place an Arcane Salvager at a campsite."

item.name: Arcane Forge

legacyPerks.name: Performance Bonus
legacyPerks.description: You have a 15% chance to receive 100% increased Merchant's Favor when you turn in a crate to the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.

legacyPerks.name: Working Overtime
legacyPerks.description: Increases your chance to gain a skill increase from using any primary, secondary, or class-based tradeskill by 20%.

legacyPerks.name: Dedicated Study
legacyPerks.description: Increases your skill by 1 in your lowest tradeskill among your Primary and Secondary tradeskills. If you have already reached 300 skill in your two current Primary Tradeskills and all three Secondary Tradeskills, you will gain 2 to 4 of a random Elemental Essence.
